name: Lu 35-138
summary: Lu 35-138 is a dual dopamine D4 receptor antagonist and serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SRI) among other actions which belongs to the tetrahydropyridinylindole group and was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed. Its route of administration is unspecified.

pharmacology.text: Lu 35-138 is a dual dopamine D4 receptor antagonist and serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SRI) among other actions which belongs to the tetrahydropyridinylindole group and was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed. The drug shows high affinity for the dopamine D4 receptor (Ki = 5 nM) and is a competitive antagonist of this receptor (Kb = 8 nM).
pharmacology.kind: Dopamine D4 receptor antagonist; Serotonin reuptake inhibitor
